title: AUD-013: a campaign resumed after its process dies reaches what an uninterrupted one reaches
note: Each mutation removes one part of the long-horizon campaign's resumption: the check that the log still holds the position the state names, the lock, finishing the objective in flight, counting what the dead process finished, skipping what was measured or withdrawn, keeping the world, and counting the restart. tests/test_research_horizon_resume.py kills the campaign's process at each point and resumes it in a new one.

mutations.name: RHR1_a_rolled_back_history_is_resumed
mutations.find: if seq >= 0 and (seq >= len(events) or events[seq].hash != digest):
mutations.rationale: AUD-013: a campaign resumes over a log restored from an earlier copy and reports work the history does not show

mutations.name: RHR2_two_processes_drive_one_campaign
mutations.rationale: AUD-013: a second process resumes a campaign a live one holds, and each counts the other's work

mutations.name: RHR3_the_objective_in_flight_is_left_open
mutations.rationale: AUD-013: the objective the dead process was driving is never finished

mutations.name: RHR4_an_objective_the_dead_process_finished_is_not_counted
mutations.rationale: AUD-013: an objective finished before the process died is missing from the controllers counted

mutations.name: RHR5_a_measured_stage_is_measured_again
mutations.rationale: AUD-013: a resumed campaign reports a stage twice

mutations.name: RHR6_a_recorded_withdrawal_is_attempted_again
mutations.find: if target in invalidate_at and target not in self.invalidated:
mutations.rationale: AUD-013: a stage boundary's withdrawal, already recorded, is made again on resume

mutations.name: RHR7_a_withdrawn_task_is_withdrawn_again
mutations.rationale: AUD-013: a withdrawal the dead process made and did not record is repeated, and refused

mutations.name: RHR8_the_world_is_rebuilt_on_resume
mutations.find:
if resume:
            # The world a stopped process left
mutations.replace:
if False:
            # The world a stopped process left
mutations.rationale: AUD-013: resuming deletes the world the stopped process left, as every run used to

mutations.name: RHR9_a_process_restart_is_not_counted
mutations.rationale: AUD-013: a resumption of the campaign itself is not counted, so it reads as one uninterrupted run

mutations.name: RHR10_nothing_is_saved_before_an_objective
mutations.find:
# durable before the next objective: what is done, at the
                # position it was done by
                self._save((events[-1].seq, events[-1].hash))
mutations.replace:
# durable before the next objective: what is done, at the
                # position it was done by
                pass
mutations.rationale: AUD-013: a process that dies deep in a stage leaves no state, or one more than an objective behind the log

mutations.name: RHR11_the_resume_counts_from_the_state_not_the_log
mutations.rationale: AUD-013: an objective the log registered after the last save is registered again under the same id
